# grizzly v9.1.4 - Table of Contents

> Elixir Z-Wave library

## Pages

- [Grizzly](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [Grizzly Cookbook](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/cookbook.md)

## Modules

- Core
  - [Grizzly](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.md): Send commands, subscribe to unsolicited events, and other helpers.
  - [Grizzly.Associations](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Associations.md): Storage for Z-Wave association groups. Supports both standard and multi channel
associations.

  - [Grizzly.Associations.Association](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Associations.Association.md): A representation of a Z-Wave association group with associated nodes.

  - [Grizzly.Events](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Events.md): Pubsub registry for Grizzly events other than Z-Wave commands from devices.
  - [Grizzly.Inclusions](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Inclusions.md): Module for adding and removing Z-Wave nodes
  - [Grizzly.Indicator](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Indicator.md): Indicator handling for Grizzly when an indicator event is triggered
  - [Grizzly.Network](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Network.md): Module for working with the Z-Wave network

  - [Grizzly.Node](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Node.md): Functions for working directly with a Z-Wave node

  - [Grizzly.Options](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Options.md): Grizzly config options.

  - [Grizzly.Report](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Report.md): Reports from Z-Wave commands
  - [Grizzly.Supervisor](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Supervisor.md): Supervisor for running the Grizzly runtime.
  - [Grizzly.Trace](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Trace.md): Module that tracks the commands that are sent and received by Grizzly
  - [Grizzly.Trace.Record](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Trace.Record.md): Data structure for a single item in the trace log

- Command Definitions
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Command](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Command.md): Data struct and behaviour for working with Z-Wave commands

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandSpec](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandSpec.md): Data structure describing a Z-Wave command, including how to create, encode,
and decode it.

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.md): Lookup table for sendable Z-Wave commands.

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.ParamSpec](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.ParamSpec.md): Data structure describing a parameter for a Z-Wave command.

- Behaviours
  - [Grizzly.FirmwareUpdateHandler](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.FirmwareUpdateHandler.md): Behaviour for handling incoming commands during the firmware update process
  - [Grizzly.InclusionHandler](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.InclusionHandler.md): Behaviour for handling incoming commands during the inclusion process

- Virtual Devices
  - [Grizzly.VirtualDevices](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.VirtualDevices.md): Virtual devices
  - [Grizzly.VirtualDevices.Device](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.VirtualDevices.Device.md): Behaviour for implementing virtual device specifics

- Z/IP Gateway
  - [Grizzly.ZIPGateway.Config](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZIPGateway.Config.md): Builds valid `zipgateway.cfg` based on Grizzly options.

  - [Grizzly.ZIPGateway.Database](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZIPGateway.Database.md): Functions for inspecting and debugging Z/IP Gateway's SQLite database.

  - [Grizzly.ZIPGateway.DatabaseChecker](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZIPGateway.DatabaseChecker.md): Does some sanity checking on the Z/IP Gateway SQLite database during its init,
then exits normally.
  - [Grizzly.ZIPGateway.LogMonitor](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZIPGateway.LogMonitor.md): Monitors the Z/IP Gateway logs to extract and process certain data.

  - [Grizzly.ZIPGateway.Supervisor](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZIPGateway.Supervisor.md): Supervisor for the Z/IP Gateway process.

- Firmware Updates
  - [Grizzly.FirmwareUpdates](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.FirmwareUpdates.md): Module for upgrading firmware on target devices.
  - [Grizzly.FirmwareUpdates.OTW.BootloaderFraming](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.FirmwareUpdates.OTW.BootloaderFraming.md): A Circuits.UART.Framing implementation for handling framing of data
exchanged with the Gecko bootloader during over-the-wire firmware updates.

  - [Grizzly.FirmwareUpdates.OTW.UpdateSpec](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.FirmwareUpdates.OTW.UpdateSpec.md): A firmware upgrade specification used to determine if a firmware image can
be applied given the running firmware version.

  - [Grizzly.FirmwareUpdates.OTWUpdateRunner](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.FirmwareUpdates.OTWUpdateRunner.md): State machine for managing an OTW update for a Z-Wave controller module.

- Requests
  - [Grizzly.Requests.Handler](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Requests.Handler.md): Behaviour for how commands should handle incoming Z-Wave messages

  - [Grizzly.Requests.Handlers.AckResponse](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Requests.Handlers.AckResponse.md): This handler is useful for most set commands that only needs to be
acknowledged

  - [Grizzly.Requests.Handlers.AggregateReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Requests.Handlers.AggregateReport.md): Handler for working with reports that could take many report frames to
complete
  - [Grizzly.Requests.Handlers.SupervisionReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Requests.Handlers.SupervisionReport.md): This handler is used for non-get commands sent with Supervision.

  - [Grizzly.Requests.Handlers.WaitReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Requests.Handlers.WaitReport.md): This handle is useful for when you want to wait for a particular report from
the Z-Wave network. Most GET commands can use this handler.

- Storage
  - [Grizzly.Storage](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Storage.md): Persistent storage for device information and other Grizzly internals.

  - [Grizzly.Storage.Adapter](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Storage.Adapter.md): Behaviour for Grizzly storage adapters.
  - [Grizzly.Storage.PropertyTable](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Storage.PropertyTable.md): A storage adapter for `PropertyTable`.

- Z-Wave
  - [Grizzly.ZWave](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.md): Module for Z-Wave protocol specific functionality and information

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.DSK](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.DSK.md): Module for working with the SmartStart and S2 DSKs

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.DeviceClass](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.DeviceClass.md): Z-Wave device classes
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.DeviceClasses](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.DeviceClasses.md): Z-Wave device classes

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Encoding](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Encoding.md): Utility functions for encoding/decoding common data types.

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.IconType](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.IconType.md): The installer icon type is used in Z-Wave Plus devices to allow
interoperability with generic Z-Wave graphical user interfaces.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Notifications](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Notifications.md): Encoding and decoding functions for notification events and types from the
Notification command class.

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.QRCode](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.QRCode.md): Z-Wave QR code
This module handles Z-Wave QR codes that follow Silicon Labs
Software Design Specification SDS13937 and SDS13944.

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Security](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Security.md): Helpers for security

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Security.S0NonceTable](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Security.S0NonceTable.md): This module is used to generate and store S0 nonces in response to incoming
Security Nonce Get commands.

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.SmartStart.MetaExtension](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.SmartStart.MetaExtension.md): Meta Extensions for SmartStart devices for QR codes and node provisioning
list

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.SmartStart.MetaExtension.UUID16](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.SmartStart.MetaExtension.UUID16.md): This is used to advertise 16 bytes of manufactured-defined information that
is unique for a given product.
Z-Wave UUIDs are not limited to the format outlined in RFC 4122 but can also
be ASCII characters and a relevant prefix.

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.ZWEnum](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.ZWEnum.md): A bidirectional map for Z-Wave enumerations.

- Transports
  - [Grizzly.Transport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Transport.md): Behaviour and functions for communicating to `zipgateway`

  - [Grizzly.Transports.DTLS](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.Transports.DTLS.md): DTLS implementation of the `Grizzly.Transport` behaviour

- Z-Wave Protocol
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.md): Utilities for encoding and decoding command classes and command class lists.

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.BarrierOperator](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.BarrierOperator.md): "BarrierOperator" Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.CentralScene](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.CentralScene.md): "CentralScene" Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.DoorLock](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.DoorLock.md): DoorLock Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.HumidityControl](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.HumidityControl.md): Types and functions for the Humidity Control Mode, Operating State, and Setpoint
command classes.

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.Indicator](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.Indicator.md): "Indicator" Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.Meter](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.Meter.md): "Meter" Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.MultiChannelAssociation](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.MultiChannelAssociation.md): "MultiChannelAssociation" Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.NetworkManagementInclusion](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.NetworkManagementInclusion.md): Network Management Inclusion Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.NetworkManagementInstallationMaintenance](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.NetworkManagementInstallationMaintenance.md): "NetworkManagementInstallationMaintenance" Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.NodeProvisioning](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.NodeProvisioning.md): NodeProvisioning Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.S0](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.S0.md): S0 (Security) Command Class

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.SceneActuatorConf](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.SceneActuatorConf.md): "SceneActuatorConf" Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.Security2](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.Security2.md): Security 2 (S2) Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.Security2.AAD](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.Security2.AAD.md): S2 AAD (Additional Authenticated Data) structure

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.SensorMultilevel](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.SensorMultilevel.md): "SensorMultilevel" Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.ThermostatMode](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.ThermostatMode.md): "ThermostatMode" Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.ThermostatSetback](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.ThermostatSetback.md): "ThermostatSetback" Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.ThermostatSetpoint](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.ThermostatSetpoint.md): "ThermostatSetpoint" Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.UserCode](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.UserCode.md): Command Class for working with user codes

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.UserCredential](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.UserCredential.md): User Credential command class

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.WindowCovering](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.WindowCovering.md): Window Covering Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.ZwaveplusInfo](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.CommandClasses.ZwaveplusInfo.md): "ZwaveplusInfo" Command Class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AlarmEventSupportedReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AlarmEventSupportedReport.md): This command is used to advertise supported events/states for a specified
Notification Type.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AlarmGet](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AlarmGet.md): This command is used to get the value of an alarm.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AlarmReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AlarmReport.md): This command notifies the application of the alarm state (v1, v2) or the
notification state (v8).
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AlarmTypeSupportedReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AlarmTypeSupportedReport.md): This command is used to advertise supported Alarm/Notification Types.
Versions 2+ are supported.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AntitheftReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AntitheftReport.md): This command is used to advertise the lock/unlock state of a supporting node.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AntitheftSet](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AntitheftSet.md): This command is used to lock or unlock a node.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AntitheftUnlockReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AntitheftUnlockReport.md): This command is used to advertise the current locked/unlocked state of the
node with some additional information.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AntitheftUnlockSet](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AntitheftUnlockSet.md): This command is used to unlock a node that is currently locked.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ApplicationNodeInfoReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ApplicationNodeInfoReport.md): Reports the Application Node Info with regards to the command classes that
are supported
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AssociationGroupCommandListReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AssociationGroupCommandListReport.md): This command is used to advertise the commands that are sent via an actual
association group.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AssociationGroupInfoReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AssociationGroupInfoReport.md): This command is used to advertise the properties of one or more association
groups.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AssociationRemove](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AssociationRemove.md): This command is used to remove destinations from a given association group.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AssociationReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AssociationReport.md): Report the destinations for the given association group
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AssociationSet](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.AssociationSet.md): Module for the `ASSOCIATION_SET` command
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.BarrierOperatorSignalSupportedReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.BarrierOperatorSignalSupportedReport.md): This command returns a bit mask of signaling subsystem(s) supported by the sending node.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.BasicReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.BasicReport.md): This module implements the BASIC_REPORT command of the COMMAND_CLASS_BASIC
command class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.BasicSet](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.BasicSet.md): This module implements the BASIC_SET command of the COMMAND_CLASS_BASIC
command class
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.BatteryReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.BatteryReport.md): This module implements the BATTERY_REPORT command of the COMMAND_CLASS_BATTERY
command class.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.CRC16Encap](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.CRC16Encap.md): The CRC-16 Encapsulation Command is used to encapsulate a command with an additional checksum to
ensure integrity of the payload.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.CentralSceneNotification](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.CentralSceneNotification.md): This command is used to advertise a scene key event.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.CentralSceneSupportedReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.CentralSceneSupportedReport.md): This command is used to report the maximum number of supported scenes and the
Key Attributes supported for each scene.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ConfigurationBulkReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ConfigurationBulkReport.md): This command is used to advertise the actual value of one or more advertised parameters.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ConfigurationBulkSet](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ConfigurationBulkSet.md): This command is used to set the value of one or more configuration parameters.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ConfigurationPropertiesReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ConfigurationPropertiesReport.md): This command is used to advertise the properties of a configuration parameter.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ConfigurationSet](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ConfigurationSet.md): Set the configuration parameter
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.CredentialCapabilitiesReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.CredentialCapabilitiesReport.md): CredentialCapabilitiesReport is used to report the capabilities related to credentials
at the sending node.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.CredentialReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.CredentialReport.md): CredentialReport is used to report the status of a credential at the sending node.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.CredentialSet](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.CredentialSet.md): CredentialSet is used to set a specific credential at the receiving node.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.DefaultSetComplete](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.DefaultSetComplete.md): Command to indicate the result of a `Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.DefaultSet`
operation
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.DoorLockCapabilitiesReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.DoorLockCapabilitiesReport.md): This command is used to advertise the Door Lock capabilities supported by the sending node.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.DoorLockConfigurationSetReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.DoorLockConfigurationSetReport.md): This command is used to set/report the configuration parameters of a door lock device.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.DoorLockOperationReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.DoorLockOperationReport.md): OperationReport is used to advertise the status of a door lock
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ExtendedNodeAddStatus](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ExtendedNodeAddStatus.md): ExtendedNodeAddStatus
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ExtendedUserCodeReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ExtendedUserCodeReport.md): This command is used to report the user code of a specific user identifier.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ExtendedUserCodeSet](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.ExtendedUserCodeSet.md): This command is used to request the user code of a specific user identifier.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FailedNodeListReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FailedNodeListReport.md): This command is used to advertise the current list of failing nodes in the network.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FailedNodeRemove](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FailedNodeRemove.md): This command is used to remove a non-responding node. It will only succeed
if the controller has already put the node on the failed nodes list.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FailedNodeRemoveStatus](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FailedNodeRemoveStatus.md): This command reports on the attempted removal of a presumed failed node.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FailedNodeReplace](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FailedNodeReplace.md): Command for FAILED_NODE_REPLACE
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FailedNodeReplaceStatus](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FailedNodeReplaceStatus.md): Command for FAILED_NODE_REPLACE_STATUS
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FirmwareMDReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FirmwareMDReport.md): The Firmware Meta Data Report Command is used to advertise the status of the current firmware in the device.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FirmwareUpdateActivationReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FirmwareUpdateActivationReport.md): This command is used to advertise the result of a firmware update operation initiated by the Firmware
Update Activation Set Command.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FirmwareUpdateActivationSet](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FirmwareUpdateActivationSet.md): This command is used to initiate the programming of a previously transferred firmware image.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FirmwareUpdateMDReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FirmwareUpdateMDReport.md): The Firmware Update Meta Data Report Command is used to transfer a firmware image fragment.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FirmwareUpdateMDRequestGet](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FirmwareUpdateMDRequestGet.md): The Firmware Update Meta Data Request Get Command is used to request that a firmware update be initiated.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FirmwareUpdateMDRequestReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FirmwareUpdateMDRequestReport.md): This command is used to advertise if the firmware update will be initiated.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FirmwareUpdateMDStatusReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.FirmwareUpdateMDStatusReport.md): This command is used to advertise the firmware update status.
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.Generic](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.Generic.md): Generic encoder and decoder for Z-Wave commands.

  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.HumidityControlSetpointCapabilitiesReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.HumidityControlSetpointCapabilitiesReport.md): HumidityControlSetpointCapabilitiesReport
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.HumidityControlSetpointSetReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.HumidityControlSetpointSetReport.md): HumidityControlSetpointSet
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.IncludedNIFReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.IncludedNIFReport.md): This command is sent by Z/IP Gateway to the unsolicited destination(s) when a
SmartStart Included Node Information Frame (NIF) is received and both of the
following conditions are fulfilled
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.IndicatorDescriptionGet](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.IndicatorDescriptionGet.md): This command is used to request a detailed description of the appearance and use of an Indicator ID
  - [Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.IndicatorDescriptionReport](https://grizzly.hexdocs.pm/Grizzly.ZWave.Commands.IndicatorDescriptionReport.md): This command is used to advertise appearance and use of an indicator ID resource.
